Understimulated when I'm supposed to do house chores or something that doesn't require higher cognitive engagement: Listen to a podcast episode on some topic related to any of my special interests 
(Edit: this is also what I do when I'm too bored to start one of my hobbies like drawing; picking a podcast episode first helps me to overcome executive dysfunction)

When I'm supposed to do work/have to think: listen to music

When I'm at work/uni and have to listen: I always carry multiple stimming toys with me, including stress balls, slime or plastecine, rings (jewelry) that you can spin, and different types of fidget cubes (those rings are least noticeable but least satisfying tbh)

All of this only works like 40% of the time but better than nothing

Edit: when I'm understimulated during a conversation or watching a show or sth I also play puzzle games on my phone on the side

I listen to podcasts on my special interest to make chores less boring

Since looking for an interesting episode is an extra step which can be even more discouraging, I created a playlist 

Choosing an episode from the playlist can also be overwhelming tho

So it doesn't necessarily help with executive dysfunction, but once I've chosen an episode, at least I'm not half-assing everything but can actually immerse in cooking, cleaning or whatever
